title: Fleet job state machine
description: The Operating Plane demo's states verbatim (core/jobs.js: queued → running → blocked ⇄ running → done), plus cancelled. Dispatch/provisioning/worker-start work stays under the single externally visible 'queued' state — no new states. parked/stale are markers on blocked, not states. Evidence-ladder rungs ride in the settle payload and stay orthogonal to job states.

transitions.note: abort before start (pickup gate failure settles as cancelled with the gate output as evidence)
decision raised; turn passes to the human
answer delivered by the daemon; parked jobs resume by re-entry (fresh task), not session restore
settle emitted; daemon then verifies the target rung mechanically
operator cancel, fleet stop, or wall-clock expiry (SIGTERM + grace → settle with partial outcome)
operator cancel or fleet stop while blocked/parked

parked.meaning: block_hot window expired: WIP committed to the job branch, task exited, capacity scaled in. A parked job consumes nothing.

stale.meaning: decision_timeout elapsed unanswered: surfaced in status/digest, stays parked, never auto-answered.

rules: settle is emitted on done AND on cancelled (partial outcome).
wall_clock counts agent runtime only; the meter pauses while blocked.
blocked-first ordering everywhere a job list renders (demo RANK: anything waiting on you sorts first).
